title: The Reason for Israel's Fall
description: The text gives a theological summary of why the Lord allowed Israel to fall and be taken into exile in Assyria. The Israelites feared other gods, followed the customs of the nations, built high places, set up Asherah poles, worshiped Baal and the host of heaven, made their children pass through the fire, and practiced divination. They rejected the covenant and did not listen to the warnings of the prophets, but continued in the sin of Jeroboam until the Lord drove them away from his presence.
